focus.label: Fractional and part-time nonprofit roles, plus remote clinical leadership
focus.note: The scanner lists only roles at nonprofit employers that are fractional, interim, part-time or reduced-hours contract work. Delete this block to go back to the full list. Since 2026-10-16 'also_list' lets remote clinical leadership roles through as well (see its note).

also_list.label: Clinical leadership
also_list.note: Added 2026-10-16: remote care management, utilization management, clinical operations, clinical quality, population health, value-based care, remote monitoring and nurse-executive roles at payers and health tech are listed alongside the nonprofit part-time list, full-time and for-profit included, when the title sits at manager level or above (min_level 3: manager, senior manager, director, VP, chief). Staff seats (care manager RN, utilization review nurse, reviewer, advocate) still go through the focus filter. These roles carry a 'Clinical leadership' badge and get a reserved share of the list like the AI and nonprofit lenses. Remove 'also_list' to go back to nonprofit part-time only.

scoring.note: Every role is scored out of 100 in four parts: skills overlap 40, seniority fit 25, domain fit 20, practical fit 15. Change the weights here (they should add to 100). candidate_years is the experience the seniority check compares a posting's 'N+ years' against; min_seniority is the seniority score a role needs to be listed at all (a miss there is a one-line rejection); level_points is what each title level earns out of 25 (5 executive, 4 director, 3 manager or senior consultant, 2 individual contributor, 1 entry). Any other key in SCORING_DEFAULTS at the top of the four-part score section of scanner.py (word lists for domains, skill gaps, title levels, pay and freshness cut-offs) can be overridden by adding it here.

fundraising.note: Development, grants and fundraising roles are never listed. A title matching 'title' is dropped, and so is any title containing 'development' unless it is qualified by one of 'development_ok' (business development, product development, workforce development and so on). A posting below executive level whose text is mostly fundraising language (at least 'desc_min' distinct hits of 'desc_terms' in the first 4000 characters, one of them in the first 500) is dropped too; an executive-director style posting with that much fundraising language stays listed and carries a 'Fundraising heavy' badge. Dropped postings are counted in stats.rejects under 'development / fundraising'. Delete this block to list them again.
